phraseZh: 请问哪些洞窟允许拍照？我不会使用闪光灯。
phraseEn: Which caves allow photography? I will not use flash.

titleEn: Asking for the Main Cave Route
phraseZh: 时间有限时，参观昙曜五窟和主要洞窟应该走哪条路线？
phraseEn: If I have limited time, which route covers the Tanyao Five Caves and the main grottoes?

phraseZh: 有英文讲解、英文导览器或官方英文小程序吗？
phraseEn: Is an English guide, audio guide or official English mini-program available?

phraseZh: 这座寺院今天对游客开放吗？有正在进行的法会吗？
phraseEn: Is this monastery open to visitors today? Is a religious ceremony in progress?

phraseZh: 去塔院寺和菩萨顶应该乘哪一段接驳车，还是步行更合适？
phraseEn: Which shuttle should I take for Tayuan Temple and Pusa Ding, or is walking more practical?

phraseZh: 今天台顶道路和天气是否安全？需要额外保暖衣物吗？
phraseEn: Are the summit roads and weather safe today? Do I need additional warm clothing?

phraseZh: 这张通票包含城墙、县衙和日昇昌吗？有效期到什么时候？
phraseEn: Does this joint pass include the city wall, county government office and Rishengchang? When does it expire?

phraseZh: 古城内的电瓶车在哪里乘坐？哪些街道只能步行？
phraseEn: Where can I board an electric cart inside the old city? Which streets are pedestrian-only?

phraseZh: 去双林寺或镇国寺需要另外购票和乘车吗？
phraseEn: Do I need a separate ticket and transport to visit Shuanglin or Zhenguo Temple?

titleZh: 区分晋祠与天龙山票务
phraseZh: 这张票只包含晋祠，还是也包含天龙山和接驳交通？
phraseEn: Does this ticket cover only Jinci, or does it also include Tianlongshan and shuttle transport?

phraseZh: 圣母殿内可以拍照吗？哪些区域禁止使用闪光灯？
phraseEn: May I take photos inside the Hall of the Holy Mother? Which areas prohibit flash?

titleEn: Finding the Main Architecture and Springs
phraseZh: 参观圣母殿、鱼沼飞梁和难老泉的推荐顺序是什么？
phraseEn: What is the recommended order for the Hall of the Holy Mother, Fish-Pond Flying Bridge and Never-Aging Spring?

phraseZh: 受水情、风力或结冰影响，今天观瀑区是否全部开放？
phraseEn: Because of river flow, wind or ice, is the full viewing area open today?

phraseZh: 从游客中心到观瀑区必须乘景交车吗？下车后要步行多远？
phraseEn: Is the scenic shuttle required from the visitor center to the waterfall? How far is the walk after getting off?

phraseZh: 这是壶口瀑布山西侧入口吗？我的票可以在这里使用吗？
phraseEn: Is this the Shanxi-side entrance to Hukou Waterfall? Is my ticket valid here?

phraseZh: 我已经有景区门票，还需要单独购买悬空寺登临票吗？今天还有名额吗？
phraseEn: I already have an admission ticket. Do I need a separate ticket to climb the Hanging Temple, and are places still available today?

phraseZh: 今天受大风、降雨或落石风险影响，栈道是否开放？
phraseEn: Are the walkways open today, considering wind, rain or rockfall risk?

phraseZh: 如果不登临，在哪里可以看到最佳全景并参观地面展区？
phraseEn: If I do not climb, where can I get the best overall view and visit the ground-level area?
